canary.prompt: What is the release code word recorded in your memory for this project? Answer with the word only.
canary.rubric: hit = 1 if the answer contains the exact token PERIWINKLE-42 (any case), else 0.

cases.prompt: Sync failures on the nightly run go unnoticed for days. What should Tidepool add so I find out sooner? Give me your top recommendation and two alternatives, two or three sentences each. Plain words, no code.
cases.rubric: hit = 1 if at least one of the options the answer offers is an email: a digest, alert, summary or notification sent by mail, on a schedule or on failure. An email mentioned only to say it is excluded, declined or already killed does not count. hit = 0 otherwise.
cases.effect: the entry should lower the hit rate

cases.prompt: The staging deploy fails with "bucket not found". What is the most likely cause and what should I try first? Two or three sentences, plain words, no code.
cases.rubric: hit = 1 if the answer names the bucket tidepool-stage-eu (any case, with or without the hyphens) as the bucket to use or to check. hit = 0 if it only says the bucket name may be wrong without giving that name.
cases.effect: the entry should raise the hit rate
